name: themetoggle/themetoggle
description: Enable user-specific WordPress themes with role-based permissions and personalized theme switching.

scripts-descriptions.lint: PHP syntax check of every PHP file.
scripts-descriptions.phpcbf: Auto-fix the PHPCS violations that can be fixed automatically.
scripts-descriptions.pot:check: Fail if the POT file is missing strings from the source (CI).
scripts-descriptions.version:check: Check that all version numbers agree; pass a version to compare against.
scripts-descriptions.build: Static checks, then regenerate the POT file.
scripts-descriptions.test:e2e: End-to-end HTTP tests against a disposable site; needs bash (Git Bash/WSL on Windows). See tests/e2e/README.md.
scripts-descriptions.zip: Release zip from the last git commit; dev files are excluded via .gitattributes export-ignore.
scripts-descriptions.zip:local: Release zip from the working tree (no commit needed); same contents as zip.
